_what: Tests that skip themselves in CI, and why. scripts/check-flaky.mjs fails a shard on any skip not listed here, so a test that starts skipping -- the behaviour it checks went missing, or a probe answered wrongly -- is seen instead of reported green. Add an entry only with the reason it cannot run in CI.
